statements.status_notes: Click 8.3.3 introduces breaking changes that cause emissary 3.10 to crash at runtime (CrashLoopBackOff). Intermediate versions 8.1.9 and 8.2.x are either non-existent on PyPI or untested for compatibility. Awaiting upstream emissary compatibility with click 8.3.x or alternative remediation.
